chunk:
deviations: |
  No dominant cross-vendor standard for construction customer records. Field naming derived from:
    - ComputerEase customer entity (customer_number, customer_type, billing/shipping segregation)
    - Salesforce Account standard object

description: |
  Canonical customer entity for construction / specialty-contractor integrations.
  Maps from: CRM (Salesforce Account), contractor portal lead conversion (HD Portal).
  Maps to:   construction ERP (ComputerEase customer record, Procore client, Sage 300 CRE customer).
  Common synonyms: Customer (ComputerEase), Account (Salesforce), Client (Procore), Party (OAGIS).

  Peerless-specific: ComputerEase customer-number is sequential and assigned by CE — DataSkate must
  consume the next-in-line ID, not allocate locally. R05 (residential) is the default customer type
  for Home Depot Pro residential leads.

required:
  - customerId
  - customerName
  - customerType
  - billingAddress
  - timestamps

properties:
  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical customer identifier
    example: "CUST-2026-000180"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    properties:
      erpCustomerNumber:    { type: string, description: "ComputerEase customer_number (sequential, ERP-assigned)" }
      salesforceAccountId:  { type: string, description: "Salesforce Account 18-char ID" }
      portalCustomerId:     { type: string, description: "Customer ID at originating portal (HD Portal etc.)" }

  customerName:
    type: string
    description: Primary customer / account name

  customerType:
    type: string
    enum: [RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, INDUSTRIAL, MUNICIPAL]
    description: ComputerEase customer-type code mapping (R05 = residential at Peerless)

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [ACTIVE, INACTIVE, PROSPECT, HOLD]

  contacts:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        contactName:  { type: string }
        phone:        { type: string }
        email:        { type: string, format: email }
        role:         { type: string, enum: [PRIMARY, BILLING, TECHNICAL, OTHER] }

  billingAddress:
    type: object
    required: [street, city, state, postalCode]
    properties:
      street:       { type: string }
      city:         { type: string }
      state:        { type: string }
      postalCode:   { type: string }
      country:      { type: string, default: "US" }

  shippingAddress:
    type: object
    properties:
      street:       { type

stubNote: |
  Created from peerless engagement 2026-05-22 by Rex. UC2 confirmed flow: Salesforce Account → ComputerEase
  customer. Customer-number is ERP-assigned sequentially — flow must NOT allocate locally. Wisconsin
  deposit rule (99% vs 100% standard) is a paymentTerms business rule encoded as a deterministic check
  during UC3 contract validation. Fields to finalize during Analyst PRD: Salesforce custom fields,
  ComputerEase customer_number format, R05 / commercial type code mapping per company code 00.
